name: Marco Macchetti
biography: Marco works as Principal Cryptographer on Kudelski Security's research team. He has a long experience designing a wide range of HW and SW cryptographic modules, from silicon roots of trust through physically unclonable functions to side-channel resistant cryptographic libraries. Marco likes looking at crypto from different points of view, bridging theory and implementation, to find new paths of attack (and defense).
